thread:
Maria: Thanks everyone for staying for the Q&A. Quick recap + live follow-ups on security/compliance items folks asked about during the all-hands. Drop any follow-ups here and we'll assign owners.

Jordan: Appreciate the great questions — we'll be specific on timelines.

Alex: quick one — SOC2 Type II: when do we expect to have the audit report ready for customers?

Maria: Short answer: we expect Type II report for core hosted API by end of Q3. That's for our hosted offering only; Dedicated/Private will be covered via separate attestations depending on deployment model.

Sandeep: To add — Type I was completed last quarter and Type II requires the continuous control evidence window; we've started evidence collection in Jan.

Emily: Can we share a simplified one-pager we can send to customers now (status + ETA)? Sales are asking.

Maria: Yep — I'm putting a draft link here: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/soc2-status (internal). Will circulate in #sales-ops after review.

Priya: How about ISO 27001? Any timeline there?

Maria: ISO 27001: target for end of next year. We're scoping the ISMS now; internal gap assessment next month.

Dan: VPC/private deployments — during all-hands you mentioned GA for VPC peering and audit logs. What's GA vs preview feature set?

Jordan: GA will include: private control plane option, VPC peering (shared-services network), and per-customer audit log export. Preview currently has limited peering + manual export. GA timeline: beta customers in 6–8 weeks, broader GA in ~3 months.

Alex: For audit logs, what retention options will customers have? And can they ship logs to their own S3/Cloud Storage?

Maria: Customers will be able to export structured audit logs to customer-owned sinks (S3, GCS) with configurable retention policies on their side. Our default hosted retention will be 90 days for view in console, 365 days archived for support/evidence — we'll document retention and export APIs.

Emily: Is there an API to pull logs programmatically? sales wants to tell customers yes/no.

Sandeep: Yes — planned REST endpoint for log export and a streaming option (Kafka/Managed PubSub) for Dedicated customers. We'll post API specs in the docs repo next week.

Priya: KMS / BYOK — customers asking for BYOK + HSM integration. What's supported and when?

Maria: We support KMS-backed envelope encryption today for hosted keys. BYOK (customer-managed keys) with cloud KMS is in the roadmap: MVP for BYOK in preview in ~10 weeks, HSM/BYOK with customer-controlled rotation in 4–6 months. Exact scope depends on legal/compliance signoffs.

Alex: Will BYOK support key rotation without downtime? We need to tell infra teams.

Sandeep: Design intent is to support key rotation without downtime via dual-write during rollovers; details in design doc (will link).

Security Bot: NOTICE: For any BYOK requests we must complete the BYOK intake form and a short risk assessment. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/byok-intake

Dan: Who on security handles customer SOC2 inquiries or provides evidence packages? If sales gets a request tomorrow, who do they ping?

Maria: Primary: Maria and Priya, backup: Dan. We will provide a standard redacted evidence pack and an FAQ. For deeper enterprise diligence, a dedicated SOC2 engagement is handled by Security + Legal.

Emily: Can we get an FAQ item: "How do customers request audit logs for a support ticket?"

Maria: Yes — process: customer opens a ticket in Support with a signed NDA for the evidence scope -> Security triages -> Deliver logs or audit bundles to customer-owned storage. I'll add a flowchart to the docs.

Alex: Small implementation question from the runtime team: will audit logs include per-token cost attribution / route metadata (which model variant served, latency bucket)?

Sandeep: We're planning to include route/model, request_id, timestamps, and token-count metrics in the structured audit events. Cost attribution fields will be included where available.

Priya: Any changes to the console UI for admin-level audit log search?

Dan: Admin UI will get a log-search mock in the next sprint; GA will have filters (time range, model, request_id, user_id) and export buttons.

Maria: Compliance question from legal: do we need to disable any features in some regulated regions? Short answer: we will provide regional control plane options; certain customers will need on-prem / private for regulated data.

Jordan: We're investing in Private deployments for regulated industries — that remains a priority.

Emily: Can we create a short internal triage matrix (Sales → Security → Legal) for customer diligence? Sales needs it ASAP.

Maria: I'll own the triage matrix with Priya and Dan. Will post draft in 3 business days.

Alex: A couple of devops notes: please ping eng-runtime when audit log schema is finalized; we need to add structured sinks and ensure logs are tamper-evident.

Sandeep: Will do — I will schedule a sync with eng-runtime and eng-ml this week.

Priya: For the SOC2 evidence, are we collecting logging configuration snapshots and IAM policies?

Maria: Yes — evidence will include config snapshots, control logs, change control records, and sampled ACL/IAM policies. We'll centralize evidence collection in the compliance repo.

Dan: If a customer asks for an independent pen test report, do we have a standard response?

Maria: We engage third-party vendors for periodic pen tests; we can share redacted executive summaries. For full reports, we require an NDA and case-by-case review.

Security Bot: ACTION: Maria created a checklist card in Security project board: "Post-allhands: SOC2/ISO/VPC/KMS followups". Link: https://redwood.internal/projects/security/123

Jordan: Thanks all. Two asks from leadership: 1) Maria — share the customer one-pager (Emily asked) within 48 hours. 2) Sandeep — publish API/log schema draft in 7 days.

Maria: Acknowledged.

Sandeep: Acknowledged.

Alex: I'll put eng-runtime on standby for log schema reviews.

Emily: I'll prep the sales one-pager template and sync with Maria.

Priya: I'll draft the triage matrix and run it by legal.

Dan: Anything else?

Maria: If folks have specific customer asks, paste them here and we'll slot them into the backlog. Otherwise closing this thread after we've posted the docs. :thumbsup:

Alex: Thanks — super helpful.

Jordan: Appreciate the energy — will follow up in the leadership update next week.

Security Bot: THREAD CLOSED: follow-ups captured.
